title.rendered: 5th Grade Parent Night at Sherwood Middle School, 4/10

content.rendered: 5th Grade Parent Night will be held on Thursday, April 10th, from 6:00 – 7:30 pm. Gates will open at 5:30 pm. Please come for an overview of middle school and to pick up your child’s forecasting sheet.
